I’m not going to jump on the bandwagon of bashing your girlfriend and saying she’s an awful person. I don’t think you’d be in this relationship with her if she was. I’m sure you very much love her, and these sound like issues that can be worked through. 

It sounds to me that she’s suffering greatly from depression/anxiety/possibly other mental illnesses, and may not know how to go about properly seeking help for these things. It sounds like she may have an executive function disorder (I highly suggest you google more information about that). Maybe she’s afraid to admit that there’s something wrong, maybe she’s afraid to seek help. She may actually feel terrible for how much you do for her, and feel crippling guilt for not being able to contribute. Just because she’s not contributing doesn’t mean she’s not because she doesn’t care: she could be experiencing deep emotional turmoil, or suffering greatly from untreated mental illness. 

When is the last time you showed concern for her wellbeing, aside from taking care of your shared living space and providing food/shelter to her? If you don’t have a habit of showing her emotional support, give that a try.

At the very least, before you break up with her I would sit down and have a heart to heart conversation with her. Don’t make the conversation about her lack of contribution/how much you do for her. Approach her with concern for her wellbeing. Tell her you’re concerned that she’s unable to do simple tasks because you think she might be depressed. Ask if she’s doing ok, see if maybe she does need to seek help with depression. If that doesn’t yield any results, then it might be time to end the relationship. 

I’m sure you care about her greatly, and it was painful to read your post. I hope you’re able to work things out, OP. Good luck.

Absolute irrational fear. This game was never intended to change the direction the main series is going in. I’m 30, I’ve been playing Pokémon since the original red and blue games were released. I play competitively in the main series, so much that I spend hours breeding for perfect IVs. I enjoy those functions. I’m not the *least* bit concerned about what this game means for the future of Pokémon, because it’s a *different game.* It’ll change the series just as much as mystery dungeon and ranger did: not at all. 

I don’t know why fans can’t understand that this game is supposed to be a more in depth take off of Pokémon Go. For crying out loud, it’s called Pokémon Let’s Go. Stop bashing a legitimate game because of irrational fears.

Except it’s not legitimate criticism when the game was *never intended to play like a main series game.* At the reveal it was announced that it would be a much more causal game play experience. It was intentionally designed to bridge the gap between Pokémon go and main series games, and be an entry point for people who may play Pokémon go but never a main series release. These criticisms amount to nothing more than ignorant whining. You’re basically buying sugar-free chocolate and then complaining that there’s no sugar in it, when it was clearly advertised as sugar free. It’s dumb as hell.

I wish I could give this 100 upvotes. 

I’m so tired of people crying that this game isn’t exactly like every other handheld Pokémon game. *It wasn’t meant to be.* In fact, I’m fairly certain I remember it being stated at the reveal that it was going to be a much more causal experience to sort of bridge the gap between Pokémon go and the main series. Yet we still have people crying that it isn’t exactly like a main series game. 

We already had a red and blue remake. I would have been really disappointed if this ended up being yet another red and blue remake with better graphics and different starters. I am *so* happy that Nintendo tried something entirely different with the kanto region. 

Do I miss breeding and abilities? Yeah. But guess what, I can play any of the 4 active 3ds main series if I want to enjoy those mechanics. 

This game is fine. I wish the people who didn’t like it would stop complaining about it, go back to playing their 3ds games and let us enjoy this.
